theme: swapnow.in reference (owner redirect: 'I don't like this theme — do something else, try swapnow.in') — airy gradient ground + colour blobs, glassy surfaces, rounded pills, soft lifts

tokens.ground: linear-gradient(#f7fbf8, #f2f5ff) + radial blobs (indigo rgba(114,114,242,.14), green rgba(25,158,65,.12), coral rgba(247,135,87,.13)), background-attachment fixed

geometry: rounded — --radius-sm:8px, --radius-md:12px, --radius-lg:18px, --radius-xl:24px, --radius-pill:999px; cards 12-18px, chips/buttons/toggles are pills; soft teal-seeded shadows, hover-lift

macros.index: Catalogue — centred statement hero (badge/h1-accent/sub/2 buttons/trust pills), glass 'On the menu' docket, uniform rounded plan cards (emoji tiles 🥗/🍗/⚖️, exact API titles + prices), numbered step cards, 3-col feature cards, deep-teal rounded closing band
macros.order: Narrative Workflow — 1 → 2 → 3 shared progress track, pill radio toggles, price summary, JS/form verbatim
macros.login: Functional app — one measured card on transparent ground, no enrichment
macros.dashboard: Functional app — card stack, JS-rendered contract preserved (plan-card, meal-card, address-item, profile-grid, btn-tiny, pill chips)
macros.payment-success: Letter — gradient circular check seal, strong headline, note, revealed pill actions
macros.privacy-policy: Long Document — one measure, hairline section rules, content preserved verbatim
macros.admin: Functional tool — token-compatible only, secret-gated, no shared nav/footer
macros.bot-messages: Functional tool — token-compatible only, secret-gated, no shared nav/footer

nav.implementation: .nav-wrap sticky wraps .nav-banner + .nav; glassy bar (blur 12px, rgba(247,251,248,.88)) with pill links that fill on hover; banner as green→coral gradient announcement strip; retracts to max-height:0 under .nav-scrolled (passive scroll listener in nav.js, additive only)
nav.auth: unchanged — ff:auth sessionStorage cache, window.__ffAuth prefetch consumption, APG disclosure menu, logout, mobile burger

footer.implementation: glass footer (rgba(255,255,255,.55) + blur) — footer-verse 'Yours, the FitFuel kitchen.' + wordmark-as-signature + tagline + minimal links + colophon '© 2026 Jadpod Fitness Private Limited' + Razorpay trust

kickers: uppercase micro-kickers (HOW IT WORKS / ON THE MENU / WHY FITFUEL) with --tracking-caps — section numerals retired with the editorial genre

diversification.this-build: N12 + Ft6, fresh/health-tech + Outfit/Inter (supersedes R2 editorial + Fraunces/Archivo)
diversification.rejected-priors: editorial build (071a2ed — board.jpg oklch ramp, Fraunces/Archivo, squared hairline, deep-green bands) rejected by owner; N6 masthead (failed gate); N1a nav + Ft1 footer (warm-consumer R1)
diversification.stamps: main.css and nav.css carry genre/macro/system comments; design.md (fresh) supersedes editorial and warm-consumer specs

constraints-honoured: plan titles render as-is from DB, never split/renamed
'by Jadpod Fitness Pvt Ltd' in nav; '© 2026 Jadpod Fitness Private Limited' in footer

admin.html / bot-messages.html secret-gated, never load shared nav
no photography — emoji tiles + type + gradient art only
